auth.resetSent: If that email is registered, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.

companies.title: Companies
companies.assignedOnly: You only see companies you are assigned to.

currencies.title: Currencies & exchange rates
currencies.rateHint: 1 unit of currency = rate in SAR

users.title: Users
users.passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password

approvalPolicies.title: Approval policies
approvalPolicies.stepsHint: Steps are executed in order. Each step is approved by any user holding the role, or by the named user.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.mappingsHint: The posting engine uses these mappings instead of hard-coded account codes.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.dropHint: PDF, images, Excel or Word up to 15 MB

import.title: Data import
import.intro: Download the Excel template, fill it in, then upload it. Rows with errors are reported and skipped.
import.openingHint: Opening balances are posted as a single journal entry on the first day of the fiscal year.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noWidgets: No widgets configured for your role.

finance.reverseConfirm: Reverse this document? A reversing journal entry will be posted.
finance.creditNoteConfirm: Create a credit note for the full amount of this invoice?
finance.creditLimitExceeded: Credit limit exceeded by {amount}. Posting blocked.
finance.completeHint: Matched lines up to this date will be locked.
finance.postAcquisitionHint: Dr asset account / Cr credit account (default: AP)

recurring.title: Recurring entries
recurring.hint: Templates generate draft (or auto-posted) journals on schedule. Run from here or via the cron job.

bank.title: Bank accounts
bank.hint: Click an account to import statements and reconcile.

vatReturn.title: VAT return
vatReturn.hint: Figures are computed from posted entries carrying tax codes. Save a return for the period, then file it to post the VAT settlement entry.
vatReturn.fileHint: Marks the return as filed and posts VAT output/input to VAT payable.

leads.title: Leads
leads.convertHint: Creates a customer (if not linked yet) and an opportunity in the first pipeline stage.

quotations.title: Quotations
quotations.toOrderConfirm: Create a sales order from this quotation?

orders.title: Sales orders
orders.toInvoiceConfirm: Create a draft customer invoice from this order?

priceLists.title: Price lists
priceLists.hint: Prices resolve in order: customer-specific price → customer's price list (quantity tiers) → default price list → item sale price.

portalUsers.title: Customer portal users
portalUsers.hint: Portal accounts let customers view and download their invoices and statement at /portal.
portalUsers.passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password

portal.title: Customer portal
portal.loginHint: Sign in with the email and password provided by your supplier

requests.title: Purchase requests
requests.hint: Request → approval → RFQ or purchase order. Approval policies for PURCHASE_REQUEST apply on submit.

rfq.title: Requests for quotation
rfq.hint: Invite vendors, record each quote, compare line by line and award the lowest (or preferred) vendor — a draft purchase order is created automatically.
rfq.selectVendorsHint: Choose the vendors to invite. Each vendor's quote is recorded on the RFQ page.
rfq.sendHint: Marks the RFQ as sent to the invited vendors.
rfq.awardHint: A draft purchase order is created from the vendor's quote. The linked purchase request is marked as ordered.

orders.title: Purchase orders
orders.toBillConfirm: Create a draft vendor bill from this purchase order?

contracts.title: Vendor contracts
contracts.hint: Contracts inside their alert window raise in-app and email notifications once a day (cron: expiry-alerts).
contracts.alertHint: Notify purchasing users this many days before the end date

evaluations.title: Vendor evaluation
evaluations.hint: Weighted score out of 100: quality {q}% · delivery {d}% · price {p}% · service {s}% · compliance {c}%.

employees.title: Employee files
employees.hint: Open an employee to manage contract, documents, salary structure, leave balances, loans, payslips and end of service.

salary.none: No salary structure yet — define it on the Salary tab.
salary.hint: Percent components are computed from the basic salary. Housing-flagged components form the “basic + housing” base used for GOSI and end-of-service when configured.

contracts.title: Employee contracts
contracts.hint: Saving an ACTIVE contract ends the employee's previous active contract.

documents.title: Employee documents
documents.hint: Iqama, passport, insurance, licences… Cron job document-alerts notifies HR and the employee inside the alert window.
documents.alertHint: Notify this many days before expiry

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.hint: Late/early minutes and overtime are derived from check-in/out against the work schedule in HR settings. Absences and overtime feed payroll.
attendance.overtimeHint: Leave 0 to derive from check-out time

leave.title: Leave requests
leave.hint: Employees file requests from My HR; approval follows the LEAVE policy or HR decides directly. Approved leave updates balances and attendance.
leave.submitHint: Sends the request for approval (or approves it directly when the type needs no approval).
leave.cancelConfirm: Cancel this leave request? Approved leave restores the balance.

leaveTypes.title: Leave types
leaveTypes.hint: Annual leave entitlement follows HR settings (21 days, 30 after five years). Sick leave pay tiers (30/60/30) are applied in payroll.
leaveTypes.entitlementHint: 0 = per-event leave with no yearly balance

balances.title: Leave balances
balances.hint: Balances are created automatically per year from service length and leave-type entitlement.
balances.adjustHint: Click a row to carry over or adjust days.

loans.title: Loans & advances
loans.hint: Request → approval (LOAN policy) → disbursement journal → monthly payroll deduction.
loans.deductHint: Installments are deducted automatically in each payroll run from the first month onward.
loans.disburseHint: Posts Dr Employee loans / Cr Bank and starts the repayment schedule.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.hint: Create a monthly run → calculate → submit (PAYROLL policy) → post to GL → pay & export the WPS file.
payroll.submitHint: Sends the run for approval (or approves it when no policy applies).
payroll.postHint: Posts salaries, GOSI and loan deductions to the general ledger and settles loan installments.
payroll.payHint: Posts Dr Salaries payable / Cr Bank (and Cash for cash-paid employees).
payroll.wpsHint: Builds the salary file for bank-transfer employees (generic WPS layout).

eos.title: End of service
eos.hint: Benefit per Labour Law Art. 84/85, accrued leave per Art. 111, minus outstanding loans.
eos.previewHint: Fill the form and click Calculate to see the statement.
eos.postHint: Posts the expense and payable, settles loans and marks the employee as terminated.
eos.payHint: Posts Dr Salaries payable / Cr Bank.
eos.lawNote: Half a month's wage per year for the first five years and a full month thereafter; resignation: 0 under 2 years, ⅓ for 2–5, ⅔ for 5–10, full after 10 (Art. 85). Verify with HR/legal.

settings.title: HR settings
settings.hint: Labour-law and GOSI parameters are data, not code — update them here when rules change.
settings.daysPerMonthHint: Divisor for the daily wage (30 by convention)
settings.wpsHint: The WPS file uses a generic column layout; adapt it to your bank's template before uploading.
settings.verifyNote: Initial values follow published rules — have HR/legal verify before production use.
settings.gosiHint: Rates are percentages of the GOSI wage (basic + housing, capped). Saudi: pension 9 % + 9 %, SANED 0.75 % + 0.75 %, hazards 2 %. Non-Saudi: hazards 2 % employer only. Add a new row with a later effective date when rates change.
settings.componentAccountHint: Deductions with an account are credited there; otherwise they reduce salaries expense.
settings.housingHint: Counts toward the basic + housing base

self.title: My HR
self.noRecord: Your user account is not linked to an employee record. Ask HR to link it from Employees → User account.

punch.title: Attendance
punch.holdToPunchIn: Press and hold to punch in
punch.holdToPunchOut: Press and hold to punch out
punch.holdToResume: Press and hold to punch back in
punch.keepHolding: Keep holding until the ring is full
punch.notStarted: You haven't punched in yet today
punch.notLinked: Your account isn't linked to an employee record, so attendance can't be recorded. Ask HR to link it under HR → Employees.
punch.punchedIn: Punched in. Have a good day!
punch.punchedOut: Punched out. See you next time!
punch.forgotPunchOut: You didn't punch out on {day}. Ask HR to correct that day.
